description: This Java class `ClusterStatusSupplier` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cluster` provides functionality to retrieve current cluster status information, including reachable and unreachable members, roles, and leader details, using the Akka actor system.

classes.name: ClusterStatusSupplier
classes.description: A utility class implementing the Supplier interface to retrieve and provide the current cluster status information.

methods.name: ClusterStatusSupplier
methods.description: Constructor initializing the supplier with an Akka Cluster instance, setting configuration based on the cluster settings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current cluster status including members, role statuses, unreachable nodes, leader info, and seen-by addresses.
